posts.body: Hello everyone! I'm doing a chapter-based game on RPG Maker MV, and i wanted to do something similar to OMORI. When the actors walk, they have a 3 Frame animation. And when they Dash, they have a 5 Frame animation. I already tried out GALV's plugins, but i didn't manage to work it out. Any suggestions?
